Product Update / v0.2.0 Alpha

Aura v0.2.0:
The GSD Engine is live.

03.01.26 Naridon Team
{/* Article Body */}

Today, we are releasing Aura v0.2.0-alpha, introducing the native GSD (Get Shit Done) Orchestration Engine and the Amnesia Protocol.

Over the last few months, we realized that simply tracking AI code wasn't enough. When an agent hallucinates in a loop, rolling back the codebase doesn't stop the AI from repeating the exact same mistake on the next prompt.

The Amnesia Protocol

With v0.2.0, we are introducing the Amnesia Protocol (aura rewind --amnesia). When you surgically rewind a broken AST node, Aura now programmatically injects a System Override directly into the active AI chat logs (Aider, Gemini, Claude). It forces the agent to "forget" its hallucinated context and resets the generation loop. It is the ultimate kill-switch for AI spiraling.

Native GSD Orchestration

We have also embedded the GSD (Get Shit Done) framework directly into the Rust core. Running aura plan no longer just queries text; it uses X-Ray planning to query the local Merkle-Graph. The AI actually "sees" the blast radius of its proposed changes before writing a single line of code.

With aura execute, the engine synthesizes atomic, XML-based plans and spins up entirely isolated context windows for each wave. This physically prevents LLM "context rot" during massive implementation tasks.

Intent Poisoning Detection

Finally, we introduced Intent Poisoning Detection. If an AI's textual intent (commit message) does not mathematically align with the actual AST nodes it modified, the pre-commit hook will hard-block the merge. This guarantees that your semantic history is mathematically truthful.
